title: Prominence on 30A Agave House Prominence on 30A
meta_description: Prominence Agave House 6 Seater Golf Cart, 4 Bikes, 2 Pools, Beach, Free Golf
description_expanded: AboutWelcome to Agave House, a luxurious beach house rental located in the heart of Prominence on 30A, Watersound, FL. Managed by Panhandle Getaways, this 4-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom vacation home offers breathtaking gulf and pool views and is fully equipped with all the comforts and conveniences of home. Whether you're relaxing by the pool or enjoying a scenic ride in the included 6-seater golf cart, this family-friendly retreat is designed for the ultimate 30A vacation experience. Upon arrival, you’ll be greeted by the oversized driveway, offering plenty of space for parking, as well as room for the included golf cart and bikes. With all the thoughtful touches throughout, this home offers the perfect combination of style, relaxation, and convenience. FEATURES: 4 Bedroom Beach House with ample space for up to 10 guests 6-Seater Golf Cart and 4 Bikes Included for easy exploration of the area 2 Primary Suites: One on the main level and another upstairs, each offering privacy and comfort Living Area with Large Smart TV, perfect for movie nights or relaxing after a day of beach fun Fully Equipped Kitchen with a breakfast bar, ideal for preparing family meals or snacks Dining Area with seating for the whole group to gather and enjoy meals together Bedroom 1: King bed, TV, en suite bathroom (Main Floor) Bedroom 2: King bed, TV, en suite bathroom (2nd Floor) Bedroom 3: King bed, TV, en suite bathroom Bedroom 4: Bunk bed (Twin over Twin), TV, and balcony access Half Bathroom on the main level for added convenience Full-Size Washer/Dryer in the home, so you can pack light and keep clothes fresh Complimentary High-Speed Wi-Fi for seamless connectivity Sleeps 10 comfortably, ideal for families or groups Bonus Perks Included with Your Stay: 1 Free Round of Golf at one of 4 local courses, every day of your stay (Year-Round) 4 Bikes to explore the neighborhood and nearby bike paths (Year-Round) 1 Free Daily Voucher for a memorable Dolphin Cruise and/or Snorkel Trip (Available March through October) About Prominence on 30A - Watersound, Florida: Prominence is a premier community nestled along the scenic 30A corridor that offers a perfect balance of seclusion and accessibility. With easy access to over 17 miles of bike paths, this vibrant community provides an abundance of outdoor activities and is just a short distance from the stunning white-sand beaches of Scenic 30A. Guests at Agave House will enjoy a variety of amenities, including two resort-style pools with zero-entry (ideal for young children and elderly guests), open green spaces, and close proximity to the town center. The Big Chill, a hot spot for dining, entertainment, and family-friendly activities, is just a short stroll away. It features a 25-ft LED theater screen for outdoor movies and sports viewings, making it a perfect spot to unwind after a day at the beach. Community Amenities and The Big Chill: Walking distance to The Big Chill: Restaurants, pubs, boutique shops, and nightly entertainment Luke Bryan's Cigar and Gastro Pub – A popular local hangout Kids Movie Nights and Sports Viewings at the Hub Two Large Community Pools with zero-entry (great for toddlers and those with mobility issues) Barbecue Areas for a fun, family cookout Proximity to the amenities of Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Seaside Only 5 miles to the nearest grocery store Beach Access: While Agave House does not have direct beach access, guests can easily walk or bike to nearby public beach access points, including Deer Lake State Park. The South Walton beach access points are all within a short distance, making it simple to enjoy the stunning gulf coast. Additional Notes: Seasonal Pool Heating: Pool heating is available at the discretion of the HOA and may be subject to change. No refunds will be issued for any change in seasonal pool heating availability. Initial Supplies: Upon arrival, Panhandle Getaways provides essential items such as dishwasher soap, laundry powder, toiletries (shampoo, conditioner, soap bar), and one roll of toilet paper per bathroom. We encourage guests to bring their own beach towels for use at the pool and beach. Book your stay at Agave House today and experience the best of 30A living! Whether you're looking to relax, explore, or simply enjoy the beauty of the Gulf Coast, this beach house offers the perfect base for your next getaway.
